response.overview: To file a dispute with Travelocity  , gather your itinerary and contact their customer experience team at (1)~\~855~\~590~\~0778 (US)  (US) or 44/204^586^5278 (UK) for their specialized billing department. State your case clearly, reference your booking number, and provide evidence like receipts or emails.  Travelocity  Dispute Charge: Call (1)~\~855~\~590~\~0778 (US)  (US) or 44/204^586^5278 (UK) The process includes coordinating with airlines and travel vendors to investigate billing concerns and booking conflicts.
